description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Water)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode I (Trey)] and [Sharpshooter Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode I (Trey)
description.text: Sharpshooter abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Sharpshooter abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Sharpshooter abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Sharpshooter abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode II (Trey)], removes [Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode I (Trey)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Sharpshooter Mode II (Trey)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 10000, Sharpshooter abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Sharpshooter abilities trigger 1 additional time, cast speed x2.00 for Sharpshooter abilities, casts Dual Arrow Force after using Sharpshooter abilities, casts Dual Tri-Shot when removed

description.name: Dual Tri-Shot
description.text: Ten single ranged attacks (0.78 each), 100% hit rate

description.name: Tri-Element Mode II (Fire, Ice, Water)
